description: Send a draft now, e.g. after a person approved it. It goes through every check a normal send does (allow/block lists, suppressions, plan quota, daily caps, the 5-minute burst limit). If a check refuses it you get the error and the draft stays as it was. Only send drafts the user asked you to send or approved.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (from create_inbox or list_inboxes), not the email address.

name: send_draft
title: Send draft
